title: Quentin and the Wolf
author: Ansel Ishikawa
blurb: Paloma Thackeray, a thief who steals memories, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
